question: Can an isolated integer-native relationship learner propose a previously absent context-AND intervention operator from observed contradictions, distinguish it from a solitary bad sensor bit, produce only identifiable new counterfactuals, and preserve old cognition under cold restoration? Does it outperform fixed parity NKR11 without falsely claiming superiority over an equal-evidence independent conjunction-aware symbolic comparator?
hypothesis: On EXACT same frozen 12 NKR12 AND worlds and 4 one-bit-noise worlds, adaptive induction of nonzero conjunctive action effects (operator masks 1..15 GENERATED from the public four input features) yields >=129/192 correct cold source-hidden action consequences with 0 confident wrong outputs; exact symbolic independent comparator ties, old NKR11 121/192. All old 384/384 retained, all 12 genuine shifts recognized, 4/4 one-bit-noise cases refused. Not scientific proof because operator candidate grammar is prespecified.

data.source: NKR12 locked procedural environment; unchanged 12 AND masks [3,5,6,9,10,12,7,11,13,14,15,7], base masks [1,2,4,8,3,5,6,9,10,12,13,14], unchanged old source
data.warm: all 16 contexts times both actions (32 old outcomes/world)
data.repair: 16 real simulator-returned action outcomes on eight prespecified contexts, first (0,1), then (0,0), followed pairs on seven remaining contexts
data.cold: 16 unseen action queries/world; 192 total; zero cold labels ingested
data.noise: Four NKR12 worlds old mechanism remains unchanged, only first post-warm intervention corrupted, 15 valid other observations. No authenticated real external source.
data.heldout_original: no Wikidata valid/test, no genuine causal first use, no original 21.3m historical dataset replay

mechanism.trigger: require >=2 public contradiction rows against frozen old checkpoint among 16 records; one mismatch is not a new mechanism
mechanism.derive: from all action0 outcomes on contexts 0,1,2,4,8 infer four context main parity terms and intercept; verify across all source-visible action0 contexts
mechanism.operators: from INPUT CONTEXT BITS propose a bounded family of conjunction masks 1..15; retain every conjunction consistent with action1 XOR action0 intervention differences on all eight training contexts; no mask known from environment supplied
mechanism.uncertain: for each cold context, produce a value ONLY when all remaining proposed operators agree; otherwise UNKNOWN_ABSTAIN
mechanism.storage: immutable SHA256-pinned canonical source bundles, checkpoint contains original warm checkpoint + original and new evidence identities, old checkpoint unchanged; no historical or accepted causal writes

controls.independent_strong: NKR12 independently coded exact conjunction control, same 16 action outcomes and candidate space; expected 129/192 correct, 0 incorrect, 63 abstain, TIE
controls.frozen_fixed: NKR11 fixed GF(2) original NKR12 output 121/192 correct, 23 confidently wrong, 3 rejected worlds
controls.old_static: unchanged warm checkpoint on new worlds
controls.random_passive: not newly claimed; prior NKR11 action-budget controls limited to parity worlds; no category-level claim of causal policy superiority on NKR13

thresholds.null_policy: If criteria fail, preserve failure, do NOT modify masks/worlds/holdouts/thresholds after seeing results. An initial test-harness bug may be fixed only without changing frozen scientific protocol.

qualification.full: mandatory complete original root regression both Ubuntu+Windows at exact final SHA/tree, independent G29 and NKR05 focused suite
qualification.real_data: no original historical 21M artifact repeat as unrelated intervention study
qualification.deploy: isolated draft branch, no accepted owner activation, no merge or main ref mutation
